maddeler.e:
يتساكن (form VI)
# يَتَسَاكَنُ (yatasākanu) /ja.ta.saː.ka.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَسَاكَنَ (tasākana)
# يَتَسَاكَنَّ (yatasākanna) /ja.ta.saː.kan.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَسَاكَنَ (tasākana)
# يُتَسَاكَنُ (yutasākanu) /ju.ta.saː.ka.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
